content_sections.heading: About CRCSRE Guwahati
content_sections.text: CRCSRE Guwahati is the Composite Regional Centre for Skill Development, Rehabilitation & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, located in Guwahati. The recruitment notice is issued under the signature of the Director, CRCSRE-Guwahati, for engaging Guest Faculty for the positions listed below.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up for these two posts.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both positions are for engagement on a Guest Faculty basis. The honorarium or pay and the length of the engagement are not specified in the notice. For further details, the notice directs candidates to the official website of CRCSRE, Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRCSRE Guwahati Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for both Guest Faculty Lecturer posts are accepted by email only, as the notice describes. Prepare your updated Bio-data/CV. Add your relevant educational and professional qualification details. Send them by email to [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent on or before 20 November 2026 .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CRCSRE Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Guest Faculty – Lecturer – Audiology and one Guest Faculty – Lecturer – Speech-Language Pathology.

faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CRCSRE Guwahati Guest Faculty Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: Email your updated Bio-data/CV along with relevant educational and professional qualification details to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.answer: The application email address given in the notice is [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Which documents should be sent with the application?
faq.answer: The notice asks for an updated Bio-data/CV and relevant educational and professional qualification details.

faq.question: Q6. Is the CRCSRE Guwahati Lecturer post a regular job?
faq.answer: No, the notice invites candidates for engagement on a Guest Faculty basis.
